name: Park Manufacturing
old_description: Park Manufacturing was founded in 1946 to solve a problem that an OEM was having with their wire harnesses. Since then, Park Manufacturing has been in continuous operation solving problems and delivering solutions to many different industries and customer bases across the United States and beyond!
about:
Park Manufacturing was founded in 1946 in Cambridge, Minnesota, after an OEM approached the company with a wire harness problem that needed solving. The business has remained in continuous operation since then, though the founders’ names and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The company produces custom wire harnesses, cable assemblies, electro‑mechanical assemblies, and turnkey box and panel builds. Its capabilities include automotive‑type harnesses, battery cables, braided cable protection, commercial and industrial harnesses, heavy‑wire assemblies up to 4/0 gauge, laser component marking, and product modification. The facility’s size, headcount, and annual volume are not published.

Park serves a broad range of sectors, including automotive, military, medical, industrial, consumer, recreational, off‑road, agricultural, emergency‑vehicle, and construction markets. Customers are primarily OEMs and tier‑one suppliers seeking American‑made assemblies.

The company emphasizes its use of what it describes as the industry’s highest level of automation to deliver cost‑competitive, consistent products, and it highlights its “Made in America” positioning as a core differentiator.
